name: Hoshino Emi
source:
She’s a student at the same university as the protagonist, but she works part-time as a model and hopes to become a professional model after graduation.

She usually has fair skin, but from a recent swimsuit photo shoot, she has distinct tan lines from a triangle bikini.

She often works as a hostess or a motorsports race queen, which leaves her feeling a bit dissatisfied.

She’s pretty fed up with the leering stares of camera-wielding guys, but it’s also true that she’s recently started to get hooked on that kind of excitement.
